messages:
ava: heads up — I’m seeing ~2.3k schema rejects on `fncall/tool-invoke` in the last hour, almost all have `items: null` instead of array.
diego: link to dashboard?
ava: https://console.redwood/metrics?query=fncall.schema_rejects%7Ctool-invoke (screenshot attached)
maria: are those coming from a single shard/region or spread?
sam: looks spread across us-west/us-east, but spike correlates with routing to the `light-quant` model variant starting ~5943204000.
henry: example payloads from logs: 
```
expected: {"items":[{"id":"123","qty":1}]}
actual:   {"items": null}
```
henry: validator is strict-json mode for typed tools on that variant. coercion would turn null -> [] but strict denies.
diego: do these rejects increment the user-visible schema reject metric and affect billing?
ava: they’re counted in `schema_rejects.total` and show up in the console; billing currently counts the tokens consumed before the reject.
maria: client impact — some customers hit 5xx when the tool returns null because our adapter fails to coerce. We need either: 1) quick adapter patch to coerce null->[] for `items`, or 2) route canary traffic back to permissive variant.
sam: adapter patch is small but needs canary deploy + test; routing flip is faster.
henry: long-term: we should add a `soft_validate` mode for canaries that returns a degen invocation instead of full reject so UX + billing are clear.
diego: agree. Also need telemetry label so we can filter rejects that are coercion-related vs real malformed output. Add tag `validation_reason=nullable_array` or similar.
maria: for immediate mitigation, deploy-bot can flip routing policy flag `route.light_quant_canary=false` for affected slice.
deploy-bot: toggle requested by @maria: setting `route.light_quant_canary=false` on service=invoke-router — change pushed, rollout 3%->0% in 15s. :white_check_mark:
ava: rolling back the canary dropped rejects by ~85% within two minutes. nice.
sam: follow-ups: (1) adapter: add optional coercion map per-tool (config-driven), (2) console: add a quick tile showing `schema_rejects` broken down by `validation_reason`, `model_variant`, and `route_id`, (3) billing: confirm whether reject tokens are refundable for customers when reject is system-side.
henry: proposed adapter coercion config snippet:
```
coercion_rules:
  - tool: order_parser
    field: items
    action: null_to_empty_array
```
henry: we should default coercion off and opt-in per-tool.
maria: UX for rollouts — in console rollout page show a small warning if a variant has >1% schema_rejects in last 10m and a quick toggle to enable `soft_validate` for that rollout.
diego: agree. Also add a sampled payload view (with PII redaction) so devs can see raw mismatches. sampling rate default 0.1% but ability to bump per-customer.
sam: telemetry change: emit `validation_hint` field with values like `nullable_array`, `unexpected_type`, `missing_required` for easy aggregation.
ava: action items — I’ll file a tiny patch to route back short-term (done), @henry please open adapter PR for coercion config, @diego can you add telemetry fields and a dashboard tile, @maria can you scope console rollout UX changes.
henry: will do PR today and include unit tests.
diego: adding dashboard card to team board, will prototype query and share.
maria: I’ll sketch the rollout UX and post mock in #eng-ui later.
ava: thanks all. tagging owner list. closing for now unless we see another spike. :thumbsup:
